description: Define adjustable parameters (slider / options / checkbox / text); each exposes its value as an output.
instructions:
Takes a Space (forwarded unchanged on the main output) and exposes user-defined adjustable parameters — each renders its own control (slider / options / checkbox / textbox) and publishes its current value as a `val-<propId>` output endpoint on the right. The value-output handles are DYNAMIC (built from the `props` list edited on the node), not fixed.

TIP: use it as a control panel — define a param once and wire its value into several nodes (e.g. an offset that drives Inset AND Split).
